title: Single-flying-capacitor inverter load regulation
description: Estimate the negative rail of a two-phase, single-flying-capacitor inverter from charge-transfer resistance and characterized conduction resistance.
formula: Rtransport = 1/(fs Cfly); Rout = Rtransport + Rswitch + 4 ESRfly + ESRout; Vout = -Vin + Iload Rout
assumptions: Two nonoverlapping equal-duration phases, one complete charge-transfer cycle per fs period; fs is not oscillator frequency. LM2662 oscillator frequency is twice fs.
Manufacturer first-order output-resistance approximation; capacitances are effective operating values and Rswitch is the characterized effective switch-path contribution, not one MOSFET Rds(on).

Steady state with small reservoir ripple, positive input, and positive load-current magnitude flowing from ground into the negative output. No interleaving, regulation, startup, leakage or quiescent-current model.
Require Iload Rout < Vin so the approximate output remains negative. Check device voltage/current/thermal ratings independently; this generic model does not enforce LM2662-specific ratings.

references.title: Texas Instruments LM2662/LM2663, SNVS002E, sections 8.1, 8.3 and 9.2.1.2

outputs.label: Signed output voltage relative to ground

constraints.message: Load drop must remain below the input voltage for a negative output.
